origin.description: Interpolate a string, collapse vectors, and expand {?} plural markers.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: Names visible inside braces. None uses the caller.

origin.details: Braces are evaluated by the translated glue package. A vector collapses with commas and a final and. {?s}, {?y/ies}, and {?no/the/the} follow the quantity of the latest substitution, or of the only substitution when the marker comes first. no() and qty() are available inside the template.
origin.example:
nfile <- 0; pluralize("Found {no(nfile)} file{?s}.")
nfile <- 1; pluralize("Found {no(nfile)} file{?s}.")
pkgs <- c("pkg1", "pkg2", "pkg3"); pluralize("Will remove the {pkgs} package{?s}.")

translation.example:

nfile = 0
